fields.description: Issue includes local investigative and opinion coverage focused on Miami-area public affairs and crime. Major stories allege excessive telephone rates charged by the Southern Bell Telephone Company and criticize inaction by the Florida Railroad Commission, with references to state-level attention in Tallahassee. Other prominent coverage reports on municipal court actions against marble-board and other mechanical gambling devices, including discussion of cash slips and a figure named Frey, and notes on the Miami-Biltmore jewel robbery case involving Nicky Montone and Charles Cali and related federal investigation. Regular columns and features include local commentary, sports/boxing discussion, and extensive local advertising.
